items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Dave Dexter had heard some of the tracks, I think, and he wanted to record the band.

ctx.x: Then of course, there was "Bean Stalkin'", which was...

Which was Bean's. Yeah, so that date turned out pretty good with Bean, which was nice. I think that's what got us the dates at Capitol, when we got out to California, because Dave Dexter had heard some of the tracks, I think, and he wanted to record the band. He was interested in...
Actually, that Asch record was some of the first...
